title: General relativity
purpose: Use curved spacetime geometry to derive and interpret simple gravitational predictions.

blocks.deliverable: Compare inertial and accelerated coordinate descriptions.
Compute motion in a simple metric.
Week 7 midterm; recover a weak field result.
Analyze an orbit or radial null geodesic.
Derive a simple gravitational wave or cosmological relation.
Report limits and conventions and complete a GR examination.

project: Derive a geodesic prediction in a specified metric and check its Newtonian or weak field limit.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
